{{Quote|Apparently, Szajin, this "Hutt Archon," has built an elite team, the Specialists, to eliminate any Imperial elements on Makeb. The Specialists are five infamous bounty hunters, assassins and murderers.|Captain Hanthor|<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=heroic|The Specialists|Makeb}}</ref>}}
The '''Specialists''' was a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that was employed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during their [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] in the [[Galactic War]]. Led by the [[Ratcatcher]], the group also included the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cheiko Bes]], [[Specter-12]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[QO-99]], as well as the [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]] [[Tarklan]]. Each commanded their own elite unit: Bes was in charge of several [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] and banished [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Specter-12 commanded [[Ghost Squad]], QO-99 lead droids of various make and model, and Tarklan supervised several fellow Savrips. The group was eventually wiped out by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] Strike force they had been asigned to eliminate.<ref name="Mission" />
